sloka: तमिक्ष्वाकुर्महातेजा जातमात्रमनिन्दितम् ।वव्रे पुरोधसं सौम्य वंशस्यास्य भवाय नः ।। ७.५७.८ ॥
transliteration: tamikṣvākurmahātejā jātamātramaninditam ।vavre purodhasaṁ saumya vaṁśasyāsya bhavāya naḥ ।। 7.57.8 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, the exceedingly radiant Ikshvaku chose that blameless Vasishtha, as soon as he was born, to be the family priest for the prosperity of our lineage.
